app.name: DisciplineOS
app.tagline: Discipline by data, not by feel
app.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

auth.pairing_subtitle: Enter the one-time code printed by the server command
auth.code_hint: The code is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can be used once
auth.invalid_code: The code is invalid or expired. Create a new one on the server.
auth.how_to_get_code: How do I get a code?
how_to_steps: Open a terminal on your server
Run: docker compose exec api python -m app.cli pairing-code
Copy the code and enter it here within 15 minutes
auth.device_limit: Device limit reached ({{active}}/{{limit}}). Revoke a device in settings or raise the limit.
auth.revoked: This device was revoked. Create a new code on the server.
auth.logout_confirm: Revoke this device? You will need a new pairing code.
auth.last_device_warning: This is your last device. Create a pairing code for a new device first.
auth.privacy_note: Without a code the app shows only this screen. The token never leaves the device.

onboarding.title: Let's set up the math
onboarding.subtitle: These numbers are only used to compute calories and macros. Everything is editable later.
onboarding.completed: All set! Your data is saved.

today.title: Today
today.meals_empty_hint: Snap a photo or describe your food in text — takes 10 seconds.
today.burned_hint: Workout and step calories are shown separately and never change your daily budget.
today.meals_empty_hint_search: Find a food and log it in ten seconds.

food.title: Food
food.subtitle_planned: Food diary: search, photo, barcodes, recipes and favorites.
food.results_empty_hint: Try a shorter query or add your own food.
food.recipes_empty: No recipes yet — build your first one.
food.unverified_hint: Not checked yet ({{source}}). Compare with the label or a table, then confirm.
food.cooked_weight_hint: Empty — same as raw ingredients: {{grams}} g

train.title: Train
train.subtitle_planned: Strength and cardio, templates, weekly plan and calories burned.
train.burned_needs_weight: Add your weight in the profile to count burned calories.
train.burned_not_budget: Burned calories are never added to your food budget.
train.continue_running: A workout is already running — opening it
train.duration_long_hint: This workout ran for more than 4 hours — check the duration.
train.empty_workout_hint: Add the first exercise — sets fill in from your last workout.
train.finish_empty: No sets logged. Log at least one or discard the workout.
train.first_time: First time — this result becomes your baseline
train.no_exercises: Nothing found. Create your own exercise.
train.no_templates_hint: A template is a set of exercises with targets. Put it in your weekly plan and start it in one tap.
train.nothing_planned_hint: Start from a template, an empty workout, or log cardio.
train.plan_clear_date: Remove the change for this date
train.plan_needs_template: Create a template to put it in the plan.
train.rest_day_hint: Recovery is part of the plan. A walk or light cardio still counts.
train.set_queued: Offline — the set will be saved when you are back online
train.timed_hint: Sets are logged as time, not reps (plank, running).
train.week_hint: Tap a day to set a template or a rest day.
train.plan_done_hint: You can still add cardio or another workout.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle_planned: PARA: projects, areas, tasks, calendar, time tracker and journal.

stats.title: Stats
stats.subtitle_planned: Charts for calories, macros, water, weight, steps, volume per muscle group, time and streaks.

settings.title: Settings
settings.safe_floor_hint: Below this the app never recommends intake and never awards XP. Default: {{kcal}} kcal.
settings.safe_floor_warning: You are lowering the safe floor. This is a health risk. Confirm deliberately.
settings.aggressive_deficit_warning: Aggressive deficit (over 25%). Hard to sustain and hard on muscle.

warnings.below_safe_floor: Target raised to the safe floor
warnings.low_body_fat_deficit: Low body fat + deficit: health risk
warnings.missing_body_params: Add sex, birth date, height and weight
warnings.macros_exceed_kcal: Protein and fat exceed the calorie target
warnings.below_safe_floor_confirmed: Manually confirmed: target below the floor

settings.quiet_hours_hint: No notifications are delivered during this window (in your timezone).
settings.pairing_code_once: The code is valid for 15 minutes and shown once
settings.tokens_hint: For iOS Shortcuts and scripts. Each token gets only the scopes you pick.
settings.token_created: Copy the token now — it is shown once
settings.keep_thumbnail_hint: By default the photo is deleted right after saving a meal.
settings.export_hint: Full export arrives in stage 8. Nightly encrypted backups are already configured on the server (age + private repo).
install_steps: Tap Share at the bottom of the screen
Launch the app from the icon — then enable notifications
settings.standalone_detected: Running from the Home Screen — notifications are available.
settings.standalone_required: Push on iPhone requires adding the site to the Home Screen first.

errors.invalid_pairing_code: The code is invalid or expired
errors.pairing_code_locked: Too many attempts. Create a new code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.last_device: You cannot revoke the last device
errors.validation_error: Please check the fields you filled in
errors.target_below_safe_floor: Target is below the safe floor
errors.target_below_absolute_floor: Value is below the absolute minimum
errors.macros_exceed_kcal: Protein and fat exceed the calorie target
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.global_food_readonly: Library foods can only be confirmed
errors.verify_owner_only: Only the owner can confirm library foods
errors.portion_too_small: The portion is too small for this dish
errors.ai_disabled: AI is not configured on the server (AI_API_KEY)
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI service is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.ai_invalid_response: The AI answer could not be read. Please try again.
errors.ai_daily_limit: The daily AI budget is used up. Add by hand or try tomorrow.
errors.image_invalid: This is not a JPEG photo
errors.image_decode_failed: The photo could not be opened. Try another one.
errors.canvas_unavailable: The browser could not prepare the photo. Try again or describe the meal in text.
errors.encode_failed: The photo could not be compressed. Try another one.
errors.payload_too_large: The file is too large to upload
errors.ai_job_not_found: The analysis was not found — try again
errors.ai_job_already_saved: This analysis is already saved as a meal

ai.capture_row: Add by photo, text or barcode
ai.analyzing_hint: Usually 5–15 seconds. Nothing is saved until you review the result.
ai.text_hint: You can dictate with the iPhone keyboard microphone. Grams or pieces, as you like.
ai.text_placeholder: 200 g buckwheat, 2 eggs, chicken breast 150 g
ai.review_hint: Grams are estimates. Fix weights and products, then save. Nothing is saved without your confirmation.
ai.nothing_found: No food found. Add items by hand or try another photo.
ai.use_ai_estimate: Keep the AI estimate · {{kcal}} kcal / 100 g

scan.title: Barcode scanner
scan.hint: Point the camera at the barcode
scan.camera_error: The camera is not available. Allow camera access in Safari settings or type the barcode digits.
scan.miss_hint: It is neither in your library nor in Open Food Facts. Create the product and it will be found next time.
scan.unavailable: Open Food Facts is not responding right now. Try again a little later.
